historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Before we discuss the dent in your car, I've found a lovely garage café.

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Their scones are enormous. Shall I book a table?

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: B
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Why does the booking need a mechanic?

historicalSeedDialogue.speaker: A
historicalSeedDialogue.text: Excellent question. Let's inspect their staffing over tea.
